usedFor: Judge.me collects product reviews, and Microsoft Excel logs each one when “New Review” runs “Add Row To Table”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Review” in Judge.me, then “Add Row To Table” in Microsoft Excel
bestTemplate.why: Every review lands as a row in one table, ready to sort and count.

watchOut: “Updated Review” fires on edits, so the same review can add a second row.
